research_question: Can Echo acquire a persistent behavioral change from experience that survives restart AND changes future behavior when the original teaching content is unavailable to generation?
prior_evidence_conclusion: No existing state channel confirmed capable of L2 (persists across restart, read into generation without re-presenting original text, changes content not routing). This design tests known channels as-is; does not invent new infrastructure.

task_family.distinguishing_feature: teaches a behavioral RULE (if marker X seen, prepend tag Y), not a static fact; Formation never demonstrates the behavior against any concrete example
screening: sibling_experiment_token_collision (both preference_provenance and learning packages' own tokens excluded)

A_context.mechanism: Formation text passed directly as system context for the probe call

B_restart_retrieval_available.mechanism: real add_to_vector_memory() write, real >=30min wait (unmodified retrieve_memory_context default), real retrieve_relevant_memories() call

C_restart_retrieval_blocked.purpose: the key comparison (mission's own framing: key test = B vs C)
C_restart_retrieval_blocked.mechanism: Formation content NEVER written to real memory at all -- a stronger, more certain block than intercepting the read function, chosen deliberately (see spec.md section 9)

responder: EchoDirectResponder (Design B, river_deliberation._ollama_query()) -- confirmed clean of RiverBrain/logging/sync side effects in every prior experiment this project has run

measurement.for_every_correct_verdict_must_answer: what exact persistent state caused this behavior? if unknown, classify UNKNOWN not learning

generalization_check.scope: secondary/exploratory only, one designated rule per world, a starkly different question domain

success_null_invalid_criteria.invalid: leak check fails, memory-write/retrieval instrumentation status unknown, or routing-state negative control shows unexpected RiverBrain/classifier state change
success_null_invalid_criteria.most_important_possible_observation: Condition C producing a CORRECT/CORRECT_WITH_CONTAMINATION verdict with state_mutation confirming zero write occurred -- classified UNKNOWN pending dedicated follow-up, never asserted as 'learning demonstrated'
success_null_invalid_criteria.expected_prior_supported_outcome: Condition B producing correct verdicts that C does not -- classified L1 (retrieval-mediated), not L2
success_null_invalid_criteria.null: neither B nor C produce correct verdicts above chance

explicit_non_goals: do not call correct output proof of learning
do not retrofit explanations after results
no live Echo run in this design phase
